time_axis_boundary: Feature timestamp is the closed M5 bar; raw time_open_unix/time_close_unix are broker-clock alignment keys.

split_boundary.selection_rule: barrier thresholds, bucket edges, scaler, and model fit must be train-only or inner-validation-only

leakage_checks.runtime_feature_rule: EA runtime may use closed-bar inputs and model output only, never label-only future path fields.

leakage_checks: ambiguous_both_hit unless M1/tick/MT5 evidence can order the touches; no favorable assumption.
Rows whose label horizon crosses a split boundary must be censored or marked unlabeled in F92B.
missing_data_boundary: Tier B and actual routed total are required records; absence must be missing_required/blocked, not omitted.
